change: Replaced parseInt(last.inspectionRef.replace('INS-', ''), 10) with regex match /^INS-(\d+)$/ to prevent NaN on malformed ref
Removed loadDemoData and clearDemoData action declarations from AdminService
Removed require('./demo-data') import and this.on('loadDemoData') and this.on('clearDemoData') handler blocks

Added @restrict annotations to BridgeElements, BridgeRiskAssessments, LoadRatingCertificates, NhvrRouteAssessments, AlertsAndNotifications, BridgeInspectionElements, BridgeCarriageways, BridgeContacts, BridgeMehComponents
Added requiresAuthentication parameter to mountExternalApi signature and applied it as middleware before the router at /api/v1
Changed BMS Admin role-collection reference from '$XSAPPNAME.admin' (scope ref) to '$XSAPPNAME.BMS_ADMIN' (role-template ref)

Replaced computeBhiBsi from bhi-bsi-engine.js with calculateBHI from lib/bhi-calculator.js (v2.1, AS 5100-7 aligned, tested). Convert 1-10 conditionRating to 1-5 scale before passing to calculateBHI. bhi-bsi-engine.js is retained but no longer used in production.
Replaced all nhvr.Bridge queries with bridge.management.Bridges and nhvr.Restriction with bridge.management.Restrictions; fixed field names (isDeleted->isActive, name->bridgeName, status filter)
Wrapped all async handler bodies in try/catch to prevent unhandled promise rejections crashing CAP process
Wrapped before CREATE/UPDATE and after CREATE/UPDATE handler bodies in try/catch
Added @Measures.ISOCurrency: 'AUD' annotation to all monetary Decimal fields (estimatedCostAUD, actualCostAUD, estimatedRepairCost, replacementCostEstimate, annualMaintenanceCostEstimate)

Already has 60-second TTL in-process cache in getConfig(). Cache is invalidated via invalidateCache() on every feature flag PATCH in server.js. No additional cache layer needed in feature-flags.js — system-config.js TTL covers the concern.
